answer: Each identity joins a timber cohort and locks a 60-credit bond to one key. Each epoch it meets: the verifier sends a pulse each member must echo, signed, within a 90-second gale, showing its token. Tokens cannot transfer, keys cannot echo twice, so one operator cannot cover many. The k-th bench costs 20+2(k-1), so the 1000th costs 2018; 1000 fakes pay 1,019,000 plus 60,000 locked bonds. An auditor burns a bond on a duplicate token or late echo. A rented echo ring fails: one responder holds one key and token; a second echo burns both bonds. An honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its bond.
